body:
If you’ve never read the Bulletin of the Colloquium on Violence and Religion, I think you’ll find it fascinating. There’s an excellent piece on the late Walter Wink (whose work deeply influences my own) and there’s a good review of Why Did Jesus, Moses, the Buddha, and Mohammed Cross the Road by Suzanne Ross (beginning on page 15). Available here:

 http://www.uibk.ac.at/theol/cover/bulletin/archive/bulletin41.pdf

I talked about my new book at State of Belief recently. A great conversation:

 http://stateofbelief.com/showarchive/2012/october-6-2012/

Did you see what happened to the son of the Westboro Baptist pastor? Fascinating story here:

 http://www.huffingtonpost.com/2012/10/05/westboro-baptist-church_n_1941509.html
